gsa_master_xlsx.note: Official GSA FY2026 CONUS per diem master file. US Government work.

gsa_bulletin.note: FTR 26-01: FY2026 rates held at FY2025 levels. Standard lodging $110, M&IE $68–$92.

mie_breakdown.note: FY25-present M&IE meal splits; first/last day = 75% of total.

gsa_pov.note: GSA POV mileage. $0.76 auto from Jul 1 2026; $0.725 Jan–Jun 2026.

ftr_lodging_tax.note: CONUS lodging taxes are not in the GSA cap. Reimbursable as miscellaneous, limited to tax on reimbursable lodging.

lodging_tax_benches.nyc_flats_only: https://www.nyc.gov/site/finance/business/business-hotel-room-occupancy-tax.page ($2.00/room/day) + NYS unit fee $1.50; occupancy % and sales tax NOT invented

disclaimer: Rates are for pricing travel into bids and employee reimbursement estimates. Not a billing determination. Verify live rates at gsa.gov before voucher. OCONUS (AK/HI/territories/foreign) not included — DoD/State set those. Lodging-tax benches are cited floors; NYC row understates.
